description: Connect screen with live feedback, a status pill on every tab, Calendar and Analysis as embedded web tabs, per docs/APP_PRD.md.

userStories.title: Connection state model with live stream stats
userStories.description: AppState exposes one derived ConnectionStatus (level: grey/amber/green/red + one-line text) and StreamStats (framesSent, framesPerSecond, secondsSinceLastFrame, serverAcknowledged, lastSpokenText, lastSpokenAt). Backed by CapturePacketSender counters and MacLink (add lastSpokenText/lastSpokenAt observables to MacLink additively). Demo mode fakes plausible values.
acceptanceCriteria: ConnectionStatus and StreamStats types exist and are computed in AppState from glasses state, link state, watching, accessDenied, sender and MacLink counters
Unit tests cover the derivation for: no link, link unreachable, glasses off, watching healthy, reconnecting, token rejected
MacLink change is additive and documented at the top of the file
Build and tests pass

userStories.title: Status pill on every tab and -screen launch argument
userStories.description: A capsule at the top of every tab shows ConnectionStatus (green 'Watching · 12 min', amber 'Reconnecting…', red 'Glasses off' etc.); tapping it opens Connect. The three-row StatusStrip on Today is removed. A `-screen <id>` launch argument (today, calendar, analysis, protocol, connect, settings) selects the initial screen for screenshots.
acceptanceCriteria: StatusPill view exists, uses Brian tokens, 44pt min height, VoiceOver label
Shown on Today and Protocol (and later web tabs) above the content
StatusStrip removed from Today
-screen launch argument works in demo mode
Screenshots N-002-today.png (green) and a red state N-002-today-red.png (use -demo plus a demo flag that forces glasses off)
Build and tests pass
userStories.notes: StatusPill in each tab's leading toolbar slot (tap -> requestSetup until Connect exists); -screen and -glassesOff launch args; StatusStrip deleted

userStories.title: Connect screen
userStories.description: ConnectView per PRD: three rows (Invite link, Glasses, Stream) with colored dots, one line of live state and at most one button each; primary Start watching / Stop; live panel while watching (frames sent, server acknowledged, Bryan last said); Test voice button; clipboard invite-link offer; permissions collapsed at the bottom. Shown full screen on first launch (replaces SetupView as the entry), from the status pill, and from Settings.
acceptanceCriteria: ConnectView exists and SetupView is no longer presented on first launch (delete or reduce SetupView to the permissions section reused by ConnectView)
Clipboard detection offers a link matching wss://…/ws/glasses?token=
Red states show the fix sentence in Brian.cost (token rejected, glasses unavailable, server unreachable)
Screenshots N-003-connect-empty.png (nothing set), N-003-connect-ready.png (all green, watching, live panel), N-003-connect-red.png
Build and tests pass
userStories.notes: ConnectView (rows from pure ConnectRows.derive, 9 tests), clipboard offer via detectedPatterns; SetupView deleted, PermissionRow kept; -fresh/-tokenRejected demo flags

userStories.title: Calendar and Analysis web tabs
userStories.description: WebScreen (WKWebView) loads <web base>/calendar and /analysis with ?token=T&embed=1 on first load, where web base is derived from the invite link (https://DOMAIN/t/NAME/app; a LAN ws:// link has no web app). Tabs in order: Today, Calendar, Analysis, Protocol. States: loading, unreachable with Retry, no invite link (points to Connect), LAN link (not available). Demo mode: web base from a `-webBase <url>` launch argument or BRIAN_WEB_BASE env, else a Seeded placeholder.
acceptanceCriteria: ServerURL derives the web base; unit tests for hosted and LAN forms
WebScreen handles the four states
Tab order Today, Calendar, Analysis, Protocol with SF Symbols per the design skill

Screenshots N-004-calendar.png and N-004-analysis.png taken with the phone fixtures server running at http://127.0.0.1:3100 and -webBase http://127.0.0.1:3100, showing Lukas's screens without their own tab bar
Build and tests pass
userStories.notes: WebSource.derive (page/noLink/lan/seeded, 12 tests) + ServerURL.webBase; WebScreen WKWebView with ?token&embed=1 + zeroist_embed cookie; 4 tabs; -webBase
